**q25** — Engine: CEL (`github.com/google/cel-go`) wrapped by the in-repo filter engine at `internal/filter/` (`engine.go:14` `Engine`, `NewSchema` in `schema.go:89`, IR in `ir.go`, SQL renderer in `render.go`). Mechanism: `ListMemos` validates the expression with `validateFilter` (`server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go:336`) and appends it to `FindMemo.Filters` (`memo_service.go:211-216`); each dialect driver then calls `filter.AppendConditions(..., filter.DialectSQLite|DialectPostgres|DialectMySQL, &where, &args)` (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:69`), which compiles the CEL AST into a dialect-agnostic condition tree and renders it to parameterized SQL with dialect-specific expressions/placeholders (`internal/filter/helpers.go:9`, `internal/filter/render.go`).

**q26** — `memo` (the memo row plus every comment memo — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:573-580`), `memo_relation` (both directions — `store/memo.go:142,145`), `attachment` (`store/memo.go:149-157`), and `memo_share` by DB-level `ON DELETE CASCADE` (`store/migration/*/LATEST.sql`, sqlite line 109). Caveat: SQLite opens with `_pragma=foreign_keys(0)` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53`), so that cascade only actually fires on PostgreSQL/MySQL. `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but never deleted (`memo_service.go:545`).

**q27** — Mechanism: the built `web/dist` bundle is compiled into the binary via Go `embed.FS` (`//go:embed dist/*`) and served by Echo's static middleware with an SPA `index.html` fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21,40-59`, invoked from `server/server.go:72`.

**q28**
```
s3presign runner — server/server.go:162-171: RunOnce at startup, then a 12h time.Ticker
                   (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:26-40)
webhook dispatch workers — 4 goroutines started by package init(), queue-driven
                   (internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-54); not scheduled
email dispatch workers   — 2 goroutines started by package init(), queue-driven
                   (internal/email/email.go:16-34); not scheduled
```
Unused infra: `internal/scheduler` — a full cron scheduler package (`internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`) that is referenced only by its own tests/examples; the server never imports it. Likewise `server/runner/memopayload`'s `Runner`/`NewRunner` is never instantiated — only its `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is used inline by `memo_service.go:108`.

**q29** — Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:156-181`, installed on the shared Connect transport (`connect.ts:184-190`). Tokens: a short-lived JWT **access token** (15 min, kept in memory + `localStorage`, sent as `Authorization: Bearer` — `web/src/auth-state.ts`) and a long-lived **refresh token** delivered as the `memos_refresh` HttpOnly cookie (`credentials: "include"`, refreshed via `AuthService.RefreshToken` on preflight expiry or on a 401 retry). The backend also accepts **Personal Access Tokens** (`memos_pat_` prefix). Validation package: `server/auth` (`server/auth/token.go`, `server/auth/authenticator.go`), used via `Authorizer` (`server/router/api/v1/authz.go:34-58`) from both the gateway middleware and the Connect `AuthInterceptor` (`server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go:213`).

```
memo updated         : APIV1Service.DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook        — memo_service_webhooks.go:20  (called memo_update_helpers.go:67)

memo comment created : APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:30  (called memo_service_comments.go:119)
```
The first three funnel through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:48`); all four converge on `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` and `:120`.
